@name: Healer
@slug: healer
@source: character_law
@realms: Channeling, Mentalism
@prime_stats: In, Pr, SD
@description:
 Healers are hybrid spell users who combine the realms of Channeling and
 Mentalism; they channel power to take wounds from others and use the enormous
 recuperative power of their bodies to heal the wounds once taken. Thus, a
 Healer could heal a person by taking his patient's injury upon himself and
 then healing this injury gradually.
